info.title: Waveform Agent API v2
info.description: v1 remains unchanged. Write scopes default disabled and require signed approvals. This service is not an identity provider. No EPICS write API. Hardening: V2_ONLY disables anonymous v1 routes (default false). Production should enable it or isolate ports with proxy ACL. Preview needs no approval; mutations require one signed confirmation. Catalog schema_version=1. Per-scope quotas default to 60 requests/minute plus 10 control/data writes/minute. APPROVAL_SECRET_PREVIOUS permits a bounded rotation window.

get.description: A successful preview binds target_id to an exact original catalog object. Before the first mutation, GET reads the current object and returns version 0 with SHA-256 and byte count, without writing mutation state, operations, approvals or versions. Unknown IDs return NOT_FOUND; missing, ambiguous or unreadable originals retain safe read errors. Existing overlay histories are returned in full with pagination.
